note: already-matching since de440bc03 (#669): a `type: array` with `items: {$ref}` and stray `properties` is `List[Item]` in both, as is one with inline-object items and a component of that shape

a parameter `allOf: [$ref scalar, {description}]` is that scalar; a property wrapping a component that is itself only a described `$ref` is that scalar documented by the inner annotation; such a component alias carries its member's description
a parameter union member naming a component that admits null is `Optional[X]` inside the union; a tuple body (`items: false` beside `prefixItems`) is `Sequence[Any]`
an inline `additionalProperties` value declaring `type: object` hoists `<Parent>Value` (response maps `<Ctx>ResponseValue`); a properties-only value with no `type` is `Dict[str, Any]`

no model for a download's JSON alternative, for a dropped readOnly inline body object or for a body only a replaced same-name operation posts; a component a bytes body names keeps its model. One reference.md line stays attributed to reference-body-param-doc (owned by parity-bodies-media-r1, manager's ruling)

a parameter's hoisted type belongs to the parameter whose type name is its longest prefix, so an enum named like a sibling global union stays in its operation's package; a root-client method's inline types and a shared components.parameters enum already land as the certified pair puts them
an operation split by per-media-type method names names its shared inline types once, from the base operation

an inline property object with `description: ''` opens `""" """`; a hoisted nullable inline object takes the inner object's description; a description beside a `$ref` (or a one-`$ref` `oneOf`) as the alternative to null documents nothing; a described `allOf` alias keeps its member's description
a `nullable: true` one-member `oneOf` around a component keeps the component optional: a response returns `Optional[X]`, a body is `request: Optional[X] = None` and the component stays exported

a reference.md parameter description is a paragraph when a line break remains after dropping leading whitespace and trailing line breaks; the paragraph keeps its leading line break and loses only trailing ones
an operationId's run of one-letter words names its request types as one word (`ZxyPbfGet`), Fern re-casing its own PascalCase
already-matching since de440bc03 (#669), which repaired it for vtex-output-parity (corpus row 3479); an untyped `items: {}` beside `properties` matches the certified pair here and in VTEX

a name's whole leading number is spelled in words (`401Response` → `FourHundredOneResponse`, `007Agent` → `SevenAgent`, `2FAStatus` → `TwoFaStatus`); above 9,999 the certified pair spells `Undefined` (`10000Steps` → `UndefinedSteps`), which crozier now matches
`type: number` with `format: uint32` is `int`, as int32/int64/uint64 are; uint8 and uint16 stay `float`
an `allOf` body whose members include a nested `allOf` merges two objects, so the model takes no member's description
an enum hoisted from a property or array element with a blank description opens `""" """`; a component enum with `description: ''` has none
a component `anyOf: [{scalar, description}, null]` alias, and an enum hoisted from a property's nullable enum alternative, are documented by that alternative's description

a property `anyOf: [allOf: [$ref, {description}], null]` is the annotated copy (an enum copy for an enum target, the nullable map for a map target) documented by the annotation, in models and reference.md

the R6 rule (settled together): a description opening with a line break keeps it in reference.md. Its document also holds agentstack's body naming a component that only re-names a union, which crozier dropped with its whole group and now sends as `request: X`
